params.1273: Given by Sir Vyvin's squire in Falador Castle for completing all Elite Tasks in Falador.
params.1292: Falador shield 4 and a set of magic lamps worth 160,000xp in four skills of your choice.
params.1274: The shield gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - Recharge 100% of your Prayer twice per day.
params.1276: - Operate the shield to help locate the giant mole when in its lair.
params.1277: - The mole has a chance of dropping a mole nose, which you may trade with Wyson for higher-value nests.
params.1278: When using the altar in Falador Castle to recharge Prayer points, you will gain an additional 2 points.
params.1279: Ability to use the ancient hymnal on the Falador Castle altar to convert it to a Zaros altar.
